name: 3D Volume Atlas Packing
definition: Packs multiple volumes or timesteps into a single 3D texture by calculating a 3D grid resolution and allocating a flat Uint16Array buffer.
summary: 3D Volume Atlas Packing packs multiple distinct volumetric datasets into a single 3D texture by allocating a flat buffer and calculating a 3D grid resolution, differing from multi-channel packing by handling separate datasets along a dedicated atlas dimension.
